violations.text: The door to the outside, located in the kitchen, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 06/22/2026
The ceiling in the ware washing area is covered with dry wall, which is not smooth, durable, and easily cleanable. New Violation. Correct By: 06/22/2026
